deadline_text_verbatim: General notes on deadlines — uni-assist's deadline is the deadline set by the university.
source_authority_note: uni-assist.de fails looksOfficial() (no .edu/.ac./.gov suffix). Per coordination DECISION 1 (2026-08-21, documented in source-authority-gap.md), an application system is HIGH authority for facts it owns (platform-wide deadlines/eligibility it sets), not authoritative for a specific university's own programme-level facts even when displayed on the platform. Here uni-assist explicitly states it does NOT set an independent deadline for Humboldt — it defers to the university's own deadline — so this record documents that delegation, not a competing platform-wide date.
limitations: Not a specific date — a policy/authority statement. Directly answers whether uni-assist.de is an independent deadline-setting authority for Humboldt applicants: it is not. uni-assist.de page states 'Last updated: 17 August 2026' (four days before retrieval).
researcher_notes: Confirms Humboldt itself remains the deadline-setting authority even for applications routed through uni-assist — there is no separate uni-assist-wide date that overrides or supplements HU's own dates (contrast with the UCAS/Glasgow precedent in source-authority-gap.md, where the application system WAS shown to be the more authoritative, more current source; here uni-assist explicitly disclaims that role for itself). This is why this lane did not create a separate 'uni-assist-authoritative' deadline record for Humboldt: uni-assist has no deadline of its own to be authoritative about. The Table-2/uni-assist-track dates recorded in this file (DL-2026-08-21-HUM0013 through 0024, 0028-0033) are themselves HU Berlin's own published dates for that track, which is consistent with this finding.
